problem:
Idle release run: eviction of one blob that 10,000 ids share took 15.367708 ms of thread CPU (max of runs 15.573666); run 1 gave 15.318833 ms. The previous review measured purge(.evictable) of the same shape at 13.43 ms.

This is a 10,000-record store over the 10 ms limit. At about 1.5 µs per holder, any blob with more than about 6,500 holders crosses the limit.

The residual follows from C-1's all-or-nothing choice, not from necessity. evict already has a .stillReferenced outcome (C-3) for records that leave while their blob stays live, so a blob's holders could leave across yields.

In either case, amend C-22 (3) so that it no longer calls the residual inherent.

problem:
Probe ZP6-overlap-quarantine (.build-verify-c-close-correct6/probe/Tests/ZTronAssetStorageTests/ZProbes6/ZProbes6.swift; debug; stepped bulk executor):
- Setup: 12 assets of 100 bytes, budget 600, target 540.

Then, in quarantine(blob:known:scan:), add the blob's bytes to state.eviction.releasedBytes in the turn the blob becomes doomed. For example, after the loop: if the blob is now .doomed, add the recorded size read before the first setResidency.

Alternatively, record quarantine next to OI-14 as an accepted residual and amend C-2 and the R13 row to name it.
